facts.fact_text: The applicant, together with a number of other members of the Popular Front Party of Azerbaijan, was arrested during the dispersal of an unauthorised demonstration held on 23 November 2006.
The applicants were members of various opposition parties and movements at the material time.
The applicant, together with a number of other members of the Popular Front Party of Azerbaijan, was arrested during the dispersal of an unauthorised demonstration held on 23 November 2006.
On 23 November 2006, the Sabail District Court sentenced the applicant to ten days' administrative detention.

The applicants were arrested and convicted under different provisions of the Code of Administrative Offences with a view to either punishing them for participating in peaceful demonstrations or preventing them from doing so.

According to the applicant, following the trial, the applicant was unaware of the decision taken by the Sabail District Court as it was not announced by the judge during the hearing.
The applicant was able to obtain a copy of the Sabail District Court's decision of 23 November 2006 several months after the trial.
According to the applicant, there had been no contact between the applicant and E.Q. prior to E.Q. lodging the appeal.
According to the applicant, the applicant was unaware of the appeal lodged by E.Q. on 24 November 2006.
On 27 November 2006, the Baku Court of Appeal held a hearing in the applicant's absence.

On 2 March 2007, the Baku Court of Appeal refused to admit the applicant's appeal of 12 February 2007 on the grounds that a similar appeal had already been lodged by E.Q. and examined on 27 November 2006.
